snippet.title: VINCIT - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
We've just dropped a new trailer for VINCIT, our ultra-fast shooter with a bold manga-style visual aesthetic - showing off our updated visuals!

Combine gunfire, movement, punches, and kicks into one continuous flow of action. Interact with bullets of different colors mid-air to trigger special effects - from healing yourself to launching enemies out from behind cover with a precise ricochet shot. Make every run feel unique. Paint it all red… and blue - with every bullet you load into the chamber.

Destroy hordes of enemies with speed, style, and precision.

It's art. You are the artist.

Watch the trailer now, and stay tuned — our first playtest is coming soon!
